blocks.text: 🪝 QCI & NSIC Sign 5-Year MoU to Connect ZED-Certified MSMEs to Global Mart. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Integrates MSME ZED Certification Scheme with MSME Global Mart for 6.5 crore MSMEs.
Strategic Integration: Combines QCI accreditation with NSIC network to link ZED-certified MSMEs to MSME Global Mart.
Economic Impact: India's 6.5 crore MSMEs employ ~28 crore people and contribute ~30% of GDP.
